title: FateBound-MC
description: Choose your destiny with FateBound! Features some unique interactive fates, a dynamic leveling system, mystical synergies, and advanced discovery mechanics.
body:
# 🧬 FateBound

🌟 Unleash your true potential with a soul-bound destiny.
FateBound is a sophisticated, feature-rich Minecraft plugin that assigns every player a secret Fate upon their first join. These are not just random buffs; they are ancient soul-bonds that define your path, granting unique passive abilities, challenging weaknesses, and a deep progression system.

## 🩸 The Fates
Each Fate comes with its own set of gameplay-altering mechanics:

### 💉 Bloodbound
🔴 Ability: Gain significant Strength when your health drops below 50%.
🖤 Challenge: Your soul is tied to the earth, causing a slow, constant health drain every 10 seconds.
💓 Heartbeat pulse: Hear your heartbeat when you are at low HP and empowered.

### 👁 Watcher
🔵 Ability: Spot nearby players through walls with a 20-block rhythmic glow.
💡 Challenge: You are permanently revealed to the world with a constant glowing effect.
📈 Leveling: Increasing your level expands your detection radius.

### ⚡ Stormborn
⛈ Ability: Harness the power of the weather. Gain Speed II and Strength during rain or thunder.
☁ Challenge: You suffer from Weakness during clear skies.
🎇 Visuals: Electric sparks surround you when the storm is active.

### 🕊 Fragile Soul
⚔ Ability: Deal a massive +50% bonus critical damage to your foes.
💔 Challenge: You are delicate; you take 2x incoming damage from all sources.

### ⛓ Cursed One
🍀 Ability: A dark blessing grants you a significantly higher chance for rare loot drops from mobs.
💀 Challenge: The curse manifests as random negative effects like blindness every 30 seconds.
🌌 Visuals: Void smoke particles follow your path.

### 🧠 Mimic
🎭 Ability: Automatically copy any active potion effects of the nearest player within 10 blocks.
🎆 Synergy: When near a Watcher, both players gain a Shared Vision (Night Vision) buff.

## ✨ Advanced Features

### 🌟 Dynamic Discovery
🔍 Fates no longer just appear in a menu. Many manifest themselves naturally.
🛡 Surviving a near-death experience or spotting an enemy through a wall can trigger a Discovery.
🎊 Reveals your true fate with a professional toast and sound effect.

### 📈 Progression and XP
🧪 Your fate grows as you do. By using your abilities and surviving your challenges, you earn Fate XP.
🔼 Level Up: Higher levels increase the strength of your buffs or expand detection range.
🎵 Rewards: Every level-up is met with a celebratory sound and a chat announcement.

### 📜 Full Localization
🌍 Every message, prefix, and placeholder is fully customizable in the messages.yml.
⚙️ Edit every string without a single server restart.
🎮 Commands and Setup
🛠 Commands
📑 /fate - Opens the Your Fate GUI to view your level, status, and description.
🔓 /fate reveal - Manually manifest your fate if you haven't discovered it yet.
ℹ️ /fate info - View a detailed list of all possible fates in the game.
